description: 3D primitive — a Sphere of the given Radius at Position (X/Y/Z, resting on the floor at Y=0), with its own Rotation and Scale. Wire into Display 3D for colour / style; add Transform 3D to compose / mirror.
instructions:
A 3D primitive source — a Sphere of the given Radius, resting on the floor plane (Y=0 is the floor, Y is up), positioned / rotated / scaled by the Position, Rotate and Scale params. No input; it renders in the 3D view. Wire its output into Display 3D for colour / style, Transform 3D to compose or mirror, or Boolean for CSG.

NOTE: the primitive carries no colour of its own — style it with a downstream Display 3D node.
